input.content: How will this task continue after I approve it?

The graph parks at a confirmation boundary; a persisted checkpoint binds the reply to the suspended execution, and the downstream node emits the report after re-entry. This does not provide an exactly-once guarantee for an external file write after a crash.

reply:
The Graph controls the task through steps called Nodes. It waits at the point where confirmation is needed. A Checkpoint, a saved record of the Graph state, links the reply to the task that is waiting. After the Graph continues, a later Node makes the report.

This does not guarantee that a write to an external file happens exactly once after a crash.

# Graph task terms

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Graph | A set of Nodes and paths that controls a task. |
| Node | One step in the Graph. |
| Checkpoint | A saved record of the Graph state that can help it continue. |

Use these names when explaining this task. A Checkpoint does not guarantee that an external action happens only once.
